definitions.explanation: Having or showing good taste, sophistication, and graceful manners.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{上品|じょうひん}な{人|ひと}だ。
{上品|じょうひん}な{話|はな}し{方|かた}をする。
examples.english: She speaks in a refined manner.

examples.japanese: この{服|ふく}は{上品|じょうひん}なデザインだ。
examples.english: This outfit has an elegant design.

notes:
{上品|じょうひん} combines {上|じょう} (upper/superior) + {品|ひん} (quality/class).

FORMS:
- {上品|じょうひん}な + noun (elegant ~)
- {上品|じょうひん}に + verb (elegantly)
- {上品|じょうひん}さ (elegance - noun)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {上品|じょうひん}な{人|ひと} (elegant person)
- {上品|じょうひん}な{味|あじ} (refined taste)
- {上品|じょうひん}な{雰囲気|ふんいき} (elegant atmosphere)

SIMILAR/OPPOSITE WORDS:
- {上品|じょうひん}: elegant, refined
- {下品|げひん}: vulgar, crude (antonym)
- {優雅|ゆうが}: graceful, elegant
- {品|ひん}がある: to have class
